xmldoc.short_description: Loaded .proto schema used to encode and decode messages.

param_input_item.param_description: a .proto file, a descriptor set, or .proto text with 'Format', 'text' (see protobuf.load).

param_output_item.param_description: a protobuf.Schema object with the properties File (the parsed file), Package (its package), Messages (the full names of the message types, imported ones included) and Imports (the imported files).

description.p: A protobuf.Schema holds a parsed .proto schema. It is created by protobuf.load and passed to protobuf.encode, protobuf.decode, protobuf.read, protobuf.write, protobuf.Decoder and protobuf.Writer.
The object is read only. Its properties describe the loaded file, its package, its imports and the message types it defines, which helps when a message type must be named by its full name.

example_item.example_item_description: Load a schema and read its properties
